title: board.pages: a module's page under Team (docs/design/board-ui.md "Modules"). Compile adds `module`.

id.description: the page's address, #/team/m/<id>; unique across modules

title.description: its name in the sidebar and the page header

order.description: its place after the core entries (Agents, Apps, Modules, Reviews), ascending

connection.description: one of this module's own MCP connections: it serves the view and the tools

view.description: the view, ui://<this module>/<path>, served by `connection`

settings.description: setting keys the page may propose beyond its module's own: each declared by this module or one it requires (compile checks); the owner's Save, shown outside the frame, is the gate

tools.description: the tools the view calls: read or write tools of `connection`, each named <module>_…

secret_maps.description: the board's native Sign-ins panel under the frame: per key Set, Replace or Clear one entry of a JSON-map secret, written by the owner's own session; a stored value never comes back to the browser

secret.description: one of this module's own `setup:` secrets: a JSON map key -> { field: text }, which the module reads whole on each use (a save restarts nothing)

keys_from.description: <setting>[.<path>][].<field>: the keys the map may hold, read from one of this module's own settings (ui_testing.apps[].name)

kind.description: password and totp are typed hidden; none is ever shown back
